3. The Sugar Rehabilitation and Readiustment Ccmmission
shall examine the financial and operating statements sub-
mitted and as soon as practicable present its recommenda-
tions to the President as a basis for appropriate action.
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
Done in the City of Manila, this 1st day of August, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the fourth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
3173
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
